description: Tristan's Bloxxmod is a fun little project for me & my friends that adds random stuff :)
body:
# Tristan's BloxxMod

Tristan's BloxxMod is a simple mod for me & my friends.

Features right now:
3 items:
  - Sapphire
  - Ruby
  - Veridium

3 blocks:
  - Block of Sapphire
  - Block of Ruby
  - Block of Veridium

_(all blocks and items come with the most repulsive texture that you have ever seen)_

Things coming soon:
  - Ruby, Veridium & Sapphire Armour and tools
  - More random ores

### Have Fun!

Need help or have suggestions? E-Mail me at: tristan@bloxxer.dev
